item.title: Microsoft HEIF Image Extensions Out-of-Bounds Read and Denial of Service (CVE-2025-62821)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.1) — binary · CVE-2025-62821. Status: PoC (input-only crash PoC; out-of-bounds read and access violation, no code execution demonstrated). Affects: Microsoft HEIF Image Extensions, the Windows Store codec package that supplies msheif_store.dll to the Windows Imaging Component (WIC). Tags: Windows, HEIF, HEIC, WIC, codec, image-parsing, out-of-bounds-read, CWE-125, denial-of-service, crash, Microsoft.

item.title: VMXNET3 TSO Integer Overflow — VMware Workstation / Fusion Guest-to-Host Heap Overflow (CVE-2026-59346)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.3) — binary · CVE-2026-59346. Status: PoC. Affects: VMware Workstation, VMware Fusion (and VMware Player) — the vmware-vmx VMXNET3 virtual NIC TSO backend. Tags: integer-overflow, CWE-190, VMware, hypervisor, VM-escape, VMXNET3, guest-to-host, heap-overflow, kernel-module, crash.

item.title: Regex2Shell — GitLab CE/EE Org-mode / Onigmo Integer Overflow (CVE-2026-110264)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-110264. Status: PoC (unauthenticated render oracle; full heap-groomed RCE not public). Affects: GitLab CE/EE (Org-mode rendering via org-ruby and Ruby's Onigmo regex engine). Tags: GitLab, Onigmo, regex, integer-overflow, OOB-write, org-mode, render-oracle, crash, unauthenticated, RCE-potential.

item.title: Windows Message Queuing (MSMQ) Queue Manager Heap-Based Buffer Overflow (CVE-2026-54992)
item.description: High severity (CVSS 8.4) — network · CVE-2026-54992. Status: PoC (crash/DoS confirmed, no RCE demonstrated). Affects: Windows Message Queuing (MSMQ) — Queue Manager (mqqm.dll, hosted in mqsvc.exe), reached via the MS-MQRR (RemoteRead) RPC interface. Tags: windows, msmq, message-queuing, heap-overflow, integer-overflow, rpc, dos, crash.
